name: Accordion
summary: Disclosure stack, single or multiple.
summaryFa: پشتهٔ بازشو، تکی یا چندتایی.

name: Alert
summary: Inline status message that is part of the page.
summaryFa: پیام وضعیت درون صفحه.

name: Avatar
summary: Image or initials, with an optional status dot.
summaryFa: تصویر یا حروف آغازین، با نقطهٔ وضعیت اختیاری.
limitations: Broken images fall back to initials on the error event. There is no remote presence service.

name: Badge
summary: Compact status label.
summaryFa: برچسب وضعیت فشرده.

name: Breadcrumb
summary: Hierarchical location.
summaryFa: جایگاه سلسله‌مراتبی.

name: Button
summary: Action control with variant, appearance, size, and loading state.
summaryFa: کنترل عمل با گونه، اندازه و حالت بارگذاری.
limitations: xs is 1.75rem and is for dense toolbars, not the only target of a primary action.
appearance is ignored when variant is link.

name: ButtonGroup
summary: Groups related buttons. Joined mode shares borders.
summaryFa: دکمه‌های مرتبط را گروه می‌کند.

name: Calendar
summary: Month grid for Gregorian or Persian calendars.
summaryFa: شبکهٔ ماه برای تقویم میلادی یا خورشیدی.
limitations: Local timezone only. No time of day. Persian conversion is tested against Intl.

name: Card
summary: Surface for a title, description, body, and actions.
summaryFa: سطح برای عنوان، توضیح، بدنه و عمل‌ها.
html:
Analytics

Overview of recent activity

name: Carousel
summary: Image and content slider with previous, next, captions, and slide tabs. This is not the range Slider.
summaryFa: اسلایدر تصویر و محتوا با قبلی، بعدی، توضیح و زبانه‌های اسلاید. این Slider بازه‌ای نیست.
limitations: Does not autoplay.
Does not download or optimize images. Pass a src your app already serves.
The picture covers a 3:2 frame. The image file does not set the carousel height.
A pointer drag moves one slide. It is not a physics scroller.
The HTML class snapshot does not include the behavior.

name: ChartContainer
summary: Accessible bar summary plus a data table. Not a charting engine.
summaryFa: خلاصهٔ میله‌ای دسترس‌پذیر به‌علاوهٔ جدول. موتور نمودار نیست.
limitations: No line, pie, zoom, or canvas chart. Children can replace the bar view, but the table remains.

name: Checkbox
summary: Native checkbox with a visible label.
summaryFa: چک‌باکس بومی با برچسب نمایان.
html: <label class="wpl-check"><input type="checkbox" name="email" /> Email me invoices</label>

name: Combobox
summary: Filterable single-select listbox.
summaryFa: فهرست تک‌انتخابی قابل فیلتر.
limitations: Single select. Options are local. No virtualization and no async loader.
html: <!-- Combobox needs the framework or elements behavior. The class contract is wpl-combo, wpl-combo-control, wpl-combo-icon, and wpl-listbox. -->

name: CommandPalette
summary: Keyboard-first command list inside a dialog.
summaryFa: فهرست فرمان با اولویت صفحه‌کلید داخل گفتگو.
limitations: Filters the provided list only. No fuzzy scoring beyond substring and keywords.

name: Container
summary: Centered content width.
summaryFa: عرض محتوای وسط‌چین.

name: ContextMenu
summary: Menu opened from contextmenu or Shift+F10, with one submenu level.
summaryFa: منویی که با contextmenu یا Shift+F10 باز می‌شود و یک سطح زیرمنو دارد.
limitations: Does not replace the browser menu for assistive tech that does not emit contextmenu.
One submenu level. Deeper items are not opened.

name: DataTable
summary: Client-side sort, filter, and pagination. Narrow frames stack rows and keep a sort field.
summaryFa: مرتب‌سازی، فیلتر و صفحه‌بندی سمت کاربر روی ردیف‌هایی که می‌دهید.
limitations: Client-side only. No virtualization and no server cursor mode in 0.1.0.

name: DatePicker
summary: Text field plus calendar popover. Accepts ISO dates.
summaryFa: فیلد متن به‌علاوهٔ تقویم. تاریخ ISO را می‌پذیرد.
limitations: Value is always a Gregorian ISO date so forms stay unambiguous. Persian display is a view, not a stored Jalali string. Use DateRangePicker for a start and end date.

name: DateRangePicker
summary: Start and end dates, with optional 24-hour times. A later choice is ordered first.
summaryFa: تاریخ شروع و پایان. اگر روز بعدی اول انتخاب شود هم مرتب می‌شود.
limitations: No seconds and no timezone name. Dates stay Gregorian ISO strings, not Jalali strings. The first open selection sets the start; the next sets the end. Same-day times are ordered too.

name: Dialog
summary: Modal dialog with focus management and escape to close.
summaryFa: گفتگوی مودال با مدیریت فوکوس و بستن با Escape.
limitations: Open dialogs are activated after mount. SSR HTML does not call showModal.

name: Divider
summary: Horizontal rule, optionally with a label.
summaryFa: خط افقی، اختیاری با برچسب.

name: Drawer
summary: Side dialog for navigation or filters.
summaryFa: گفتگوی کناری برای ناوبری یا فیلتر.

name: DropdownMenu
summary: Menu button with keyboard navigation and one submenu level.
summaryFa: دکمهٔ منو با ناوبری صفحه‌کلید و یک سطح زیرمنو.
limitations: One submenu level. Deeper items are not opened.
Typeahead matches a label prefix. Letters typed within half a second narrow it; the same letter cycles.

name: EmptyState
summary: Explains an empty collection and offers the next action.
summaryFa: مجموعهٔ خالی را توضیح می‌دهد و عمل بعدی را پیشنهاد می‌کند.
html:
No invoices

Create the first invoice to see it here.

name: FileUpload
summary: Local file selection with type and size checks. It does not upload.
summaryFa: انتخاب محلی پرونده با بررسی نوع و اندازه. بارگذاری نمی‌کند.
limitations: Does not upload to a server. Rejected files are reported in the error list and are not executed.

name: Flex
summary: Inline row with wrap and alignment options.
summaryFa: ردیف با شکست و تراز.

name: Footer
summary: Content info landmark.
summaryFa: ناحیهٔ اطلاعات صفحه.

name: FormField
summary: Connects label, control, hint, and error by id.
summaryFa: برچسب، کنترل، راهنما و خطا را با شناسه وصل می‌کند.
limitations: Context wiring is implemented in React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Marko, and Ember. HTML users set ids manually.
html: Enter a valid email

name: FormMessage
summary: Hint or error text with the correct role.
summaryFa: متن راهنما یا خطا با نقش درست.

name: Grid
summary: Responsive 1 to 4 column grid. The column count follows the grid width, not the viewport.
summaryFa: شبکهٔ واکنش‌گرا از ۱ تا ۴ ستون. تعداد ستون از عرض خود شبکه می‌آید، نه از عرض پنجره.
limitations: Collapses to one column when the grid is narrower than 48rem. Three and four columns use two tracks from 48rem to 64rem. Not a masonry layout.

name: IconButton
summary: Square button that requires an accessible name.
summaryFa: دکمهٔ مربعی که نام دسترس‌پذیر لازم دارد.
html: <button class="wpl-icon-btn wpl-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg class="wpl-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 7l10 10M17 7 7 17"/></svg></button>

name: Input
summary: Single-line text field.
summaryFa: فیلد متن تک‌خطی.

name: Kbd
summary: Visual keyboard key. It does not register a shortcut.
summaryFa: کلید صفحه‌کلید بصری. میانبر ثبت نمی‌کند.
limitations: Visual only. Pair it with a real keydown listener in your application if the shortcut must work.

name: Label
summary: Form label associated by htmlFor.
summaryFa: برچسب فرم با htmlFor.

name: Link
summary: Text link. External links receive safe rel and target.
summaryFa: پیوند متنی. پیوند بیرونی rel امن می‌گیرد.

name: List
summary: Stacked list of title, description, and optional trailing action.
summaryFa: فهرست پشته‌ای با عنوان، توضیح و عمل انتهایی اختیاری.

name: Modal
summary: Dialog preset that is always modal.
summaryFa: پیش‌تنظیم Dialog که همیشه مودال است.
limitations: This is a Dialog preset, not a second focus system.

name: Navbar
summary: Sticky header with a collapsible menu.
summaryFa: سربرگ چسبان با منوی جمع‌شو.
limitations: The menu collapses at a 48rem viewport or a 36rem container. It is CSS, not a resize observer.

name: NavigationMenu
summary: Horizontal list of links.
summaryFa: فهرست افقی پیوندها.
limitations: No mega-menu panels in 0.1.0.

name: Notification
summary: Persistent inline notice. Its tone follows the theme, and dismiss is optional.
summaryFa: اعلان ماندگار درون صفحه. لحن از تم می‌آید و بستن اختیاری است.
limitations: Not a push-notification service and not a toast. The close button appears only when a dismiss handler is passed. Angular and Lit use the dismissable prop for that button.
html:
Saved

The sample stayed in this tab.

name: NumberField
summary: Numeric field with decrease and increase buttons. The value snaps to the step.
summaryFa: فیلد عددی با دکمه‌های کم و زیاد. مقدار روی گام می‌نشیند.
limitations: Does not format currency or locale grouping inside the input. The stored value is a number.
An unfinished draft, such as a trailing decimal, is kept until blur, then snapped or restored.

name: OtpField
summary: One-time-code field. It does not send or verify a code.
summaryFa: فیلد رمز یک‌بارمصرف. کد را ارسال یا بررسی نمی‌کند.
limitations: Does not send or verify a code.
The value is left-packed. Typing past the current end appends.

name: PageHeader
summary: Title, description, and action row.
summaryFa: عنوان، توضیح و ردیف عمل.

name: Pagination
summary: Page controls with a current page.
summaryFa: کنترل صفحه‌ها با صفحهٔ جاری.

name: PasswordField
summary: Password field with a visible label and a reveal toggle. It does not score strength.
summaryFa: فیلد رمز با برچسب نمایان و دکمهٔ نمایش. قدرت رمز را نمره نمی‌دهد.
limitations: Does not score strength or talk to an identity provider.
Reveal shows the value on screen.

name: Popover
summary: Anchored non-modal panel.
summaryFa: پنل غیرمودال متصل به یک لنگر.
limitations: No hover-open mode. Use Tooltip for hover hints.
html: Settles on the next business day.

name: Progress
summary: Determinate or indeterminate progress.
summaryFa: پیشرفت مشخص یا نامشخص.

name: RadioGroup
summary: Named native radios with a legend.
summaryFa: رادیوهای بومی هم‌نام با legend.

name: RangeSlider
summary: Two thumbs for a numeric start and end. A thumb stops at the other thumb.
summaryFa: دو دستگیره برای شروع و پایان عددی. دستگیره روی دستگیرهٔ دیگر نمی‌پرد.
limitations: When the thumbs overlap, the pointer hits the end thumb. The start thumb stays reachable from the keyboard.
The HTML classes draw the track. Ordering the two values is done by the React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Marko, and Ember components.

name: Rating
summary: Star rating as a radio group. It does not submit a review by itself.
summaryFa: امتیاز ستاره‌ای به‌صورت گروه رادیویی. خودش بازبینی را ارسال نمی‌کند.
limitations: Does not submit a review by itself. Read the value from your form.
max is clamped from 1 to 10.
html: <fieldset class="wpl-rating"><legend>Workspace quality</legend><label><input type="radio" name="quality" value="4" checked /> 4 of 5</label></fieldset>

name: ResponsiveLayout
summary: Sidebar plus main. The sidebar stacks when this layout is narrower than 40rem.
summaryFa: نوار کناری به‌علاوهٔ بدنه. اگر خودِ چیدمان از ۴۰rem باریک‌تر شود، پشته می‌شود.
limitations: Collapse is a 40rem container query on the layout, not the viewport. The open flag only shows the sidebar while it is stacked.

name: SearchInput
summary: Search field with a clear button.
summaryFa: فیلد جستجو با دکمهٔ پاک‌کردن.

name: Select
summary: Styled native select. Use Combobox for a custom listbox.
summaryFa: سلکت بومی استایل‌شده. برای فهرست سفارشی از Combobox استفاده کنید.
limitations: Not a custom-styled popup. That is Combobox.

name: Separator
summary: Orientation-aware non-text separator.
summaryFa: جداکنندهٔ بدون متن با جهت.

name: Sidebar
summary: Vertical navigation landmark.
summaryFa: ناوبری عمودی.

name: Skeleton
summary: Placeholder block while content loads.
summaryFa: بلوک جایگزین هنگام بارگذاری.
limitations: Not a content layout detector. You size each placeholder.

name: Slider
summary: Native range input with a visible value.
summaryFa: ورودی بازهٔ بومی با مقدار نمایان.
limitations: Single thumb only. Use RangeSlider for a start and end value.

name: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate progress indicator.
summaryFa: نشانگر پیشرفت نامشخص.

name: SplitPane
summary: Two panes with a keyboard-resizable separator.
summaryFa: دو قاب با جداکنندهٔ قابل تغییر از صفحه‌کلید.
limitations: Horizontal split only. No nested persistence.

name: Stack
summary: Vertical stack with a gap token.
summaryFa: پشتهٔ عمودی با توکن فاصله.

name: StatCard
summary: Label, value, and hint. It does not invent numbers.
summaryFa: برچسب، مقدار و راهنما. عدد نمی‌سازد.
limitations: No sparkline and no live data source.
html:
Open invoices

12

Sample data

name: Steps
summary: Checkout or setup progress. Linear mode blocks future steps until the value moves forward.
summaryFa: پیشرفت پرداخت یا راه‌اندازی. حالت خطی مرحله‌های آینده را تا جلو رفتن مقدار می‌بندد.
limitations: Does not validate a form or persist progress. Move the value from your own Next control.
html: 1. 1Account

name: Switch
summary: Boolean switch with role="switch".
summaryFa: کلید بولی با role="switch".

name: Table
summary: Semantic table wrapper with a caption.
summaryFa: پوشش جدول معنایی با caption.
limitations: Static markup. Sorting and filtering are DataTable.

name: Tabs
summary: Automatic-activation tabs.
summaryFa: زبانه‌ها با فعال‌سازی خودکار.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text field.
summaryFa: فیلد متن چندخطی.

name: Timeline
summary: Ordered events with time elements.
summaryFa: رویدادهای مرتب با عنصر time.

name: Toast
summary: Transient message in a live region.
summaryFa: پیام گذرا در ناحیهٔ زنده.
limitations: Requires WhitePlumeriaProvider or ToastProvider. Auto-dismiss default is 5 seconds and is cancelled under reduced motion.

name: ToggleGroup
summary: Joined buttons for one choice. Arrow keys follow reading direction. This is not RadioGroup.
summaryFa: دکمه‌های به‌هم‌پیوسته برای یک انتخاب. کلیدهای جهت، جهت نوشتار را دنبال می‌کنند. این رادیو نیست.
limitations: One value. It does not select several items.
Not a set of independent switches. Use Checkbox or Switch for that.
Not a labeled radio list. Use RadioGroup when the choice should look like a radio.
html: Appearance

name: Tooltip
summary: Supplemental hint on hover and keyboard focus.
summaryFa: راهنمای تکمیلی با هاور و فوکوس صفحه‌کلید.
limitations: Not shown as the only path on touch. Delay is 400ms. Escape dismisses.

name: TreeView
summary: Expandable tree with arrow-key navigation.
summaryFa: درخت بازشو با ناوبری کلیدهای جهت.
limitations: No drag and drop. No virtualization.

name: ValidationMessage
summary: Alias of FormMessage with tone="error".
summaryFa: معادل FormMessage با tone="error".
limitations: Preset of FormMessage, not a second validation engine.
